notes.title: Divine Gems Fraud Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello all. We have some upcoming changes to purchasing Divine Gems that will help make our game a safer place. Fraud in the Marketplace has caused ongoing issues that hurt the in-game economy and disrupt balance. To prevent further abuse and protect the integrity of the ecosystem, we’re updating our previous fraud measures.[/p][p][b]All Divine Gems packages purchased on Steam will now be pending for a 72-hour period before they can be used in the Marketplace.[/b] [/p][p]Please see a detailed breakdown below:[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Diving Gems Purchasing Update Details[/b][/h3][p]All Divine Gems packages will have 100% of the Gems within the packages flagged as (Pending). (Pending) Gems cannot be used on the Marketplace for 72-hours. Players can still utilize (Pending) Gems on the Divine Gem Shop (inside the Hongmoon Store) and purchase the Battle Pass without any limitations. After 72-hours (Pending) Gems will automatically be converted to their standard Divine Gem balance.[/p][p]To confirm or view how many Divine Gems are (Pending) simply mouseover your Divine Gem balance in-game, and it will show you how many Diving Gems are (Pending).[/p][p][/p][p][b]TL;DR[/b][/p][list][*][p]100% of Gems purchased on Steam will be on a 72-hour hold for use [i]only[/i] in the Marketplace[/p][/*][*][p]Purchases in the Hongmoon Store / Divine Gem Shop and for Battle Pass will not be affected.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your understanding as we work to combat harmful activity. Please keep these changes and new processing time in mind when making a new Divine Gems purchase. We will continue to monitor these changes and will always strive to make any improvements to this system in the future.[/p][p] [/p]

notes.title: Marketplace Update
notes.notes: [p]Hello players, [/p][p]We apologize for the inconvenience while our Marketplace has been down this week. Thank you for being patient during this time and we appreciate all of you who have supported us as we investigate acts of fraud that happened during the Steam launch. We would now like to inform you of the results of the investigation and what we did to help repair the Marketplace.[/p][p][/p][p][b]What Happened?[/b][/p][p]Before the Steam launch, our team put forth several protective measures to combat potential fraud. One of these measures was adding the (pending) gems in our Divine Gems Fraud Update before launch, that could limit the number of Divine Gems purchased and that were immediately useable. Unfortunately, this plan did not fully work in combatting fraud and malicious accounts were able to exploit this heavily in a short period of time. As a result, our Marketplace suffered greatly.[/p][p][/p][p][b]How Did We Fix This?[/b][/p][list][*][p]All accounts that committed direct fraud were immediately banned and their account items and gems were confiscated.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]After this, we brought down the Marketplace for a week to investigate the damage done by the accounts who committed fraud and flooded the market with fraudulent Divine Gems.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]During the investigation, we first fixed the way in which malicious accounts originally exploited the system.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Next, we discovered that several players actively engaged in RMT by purchasing the fraudulent gems from illegal third-party sites.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]For accounts that actively participated in this RMT, we have sanctioned their accounts for 7-days and removed the fraudulent Divine Gems from their accounts. After we removed the Divine Gems, their accounts were restored. As a reminder, for players who obtain two offenses on their account for infractions such as RMT, they will be permanently banned in the future.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you again for your support and we look forward to re-opening the Marketplace today.[/p]

notes.title: Marketplace Update
notes.notes:
[p]Hello Crickets,[/p][p]
Once again, thank you for your continued patience as we deal with our current Marketplace issue. We appreciate your support and the information you provided during this time. Please see below for an update on this occurrence from our team.
[/p][p][b]Summary[/b][/p][p]
Before the Steam launch, our team put forth several protective measures to combat potential fraud. One of these measures was adding the (pending) gems in our Divine Gems Fraud Update before launch, that could limit the number of Divine Gems purchased and that were immediately useable. Unfortunately, this plan did not fully work in combatting fraud and malicious accounts were able to exploit this heavily in a short period of time. As a result, our Marketplace suffered greatly.[/p][p]
[b]How We’re Fixing This[/b][/p][p]All accounts that committed direct fraud have already been banned and their account items have been confiscated.[b]
[/b]
Our next goal is to remove fraudulent excess gems from the economy. To do this, we will temporarily bring down the NA and EU Marketplace for 1 week to investigate all transactions associated with those malicious accounts. The World Boss auction will also not be available during this week. During this time, we will remove all gems and items deemed to be directly related to fraudulent accounts. We will provide you with more information after the investigation is completed.

[b]What Will Happen with My Current Marketplace Items?
[/b]
All items that were on the Marketplace before the latest maintenance will be removed and returned to the seller.

[b]What We’re Doing for Affected Players
[/b]
During this investigation, the Marketplace will not be available for 1 week. We apologize for this inconvenience, but it will be necessary to preserve and repair the integrity of the market.  In the meantime, we would like to offer compensation to all players:
[/p][list][*][p]    During the week-long investigation, we will provide an Attendance Event that will compensate players and aid in progression without a Marketplace.  [/p][/*][*][p]    The Attendance Event will have 7 days of rewards, but we will allow you to complete it in 14 days for those who are not able to log in daily.  [/p][/*][*][p]    Additionally, we will also close the current Attendance Event and automatically give the full 21 days of rewards to all players who have already logged in during this month’s attendance book.  [/p][/*][*][p]    Please stay tuned for a full breakdown of these rewards.  [/p][/*][/list][p]In summary, by closing the Marketplace for a short time and working on the issues, we can then re-open and bring back the gameplay experience you were hoping for. Thank you again for supporting us during this unfortunate time. We hope the above activities will help provide a rewarding experience that will help you progress while our Marketplace is repaired.[/p]
